categories.prompt: Name an Aleforge local
categories.blurb: Anyone who lives or works in Aleforge, past or present. Not a Liquor King.

categories.prompt: Name an Aleforge official or office-holder
categories.blurb: Mayors, advisors, sheriffs, comptrollers, Color Guard captains. Past or present.

categories.prompt: Name a place in Aleforge
categories.blurb: Buildings, streets and landmarks in the brewing capital of the Isles.

categories.prompt: Name an animal from the lore
categories.blurb: Pets, mounts, mules, a worm named Clancy, and one very unlucky cow. Not monsters.

categories.prompt: Name a place beyond the Pintland mainland
categories.blurb: Where the Kings came from, passed through, got frozen, or got banished to.

categories.prompt: Name a business or company
categories.blurb: Corporations, shops, papers and farms. Anyone selling something.

categories.prompt: Name a holiday, keg-day or season
categories.blurb: Anything on the Pintland calendar: the nine days of the Keg, the three seasons, or a feast.

categories.prompt: Name a creature, beast or monster
categories.blurb: Great beasts, small sprites, and everything that chased the Kings through a dark hallway.

categories.prompt: Name something tied to John Cum or the Cumstead
categories.blurb: The great wheat farm, the family behind it, and how it all went wrong.

categories.prompt: Name a cursed, sacred or mysterious site
categories.blurb: Places that hum, whisper, swallow people, or should have stayed sealed.

categories.prompt: Name a book, journal, letter or document
categories.blurb: Anything written down: tomes, diaries, manuals, ledgers, love letters, ransom notes.

categories.prompt: Name a drink or brew
categories.blurb: Anything poured, chugged, tithed, or banned somewhere in the Isles.

categories.prompt: Name something tied to the Drunken Trials
categories.blurb: Aleforge's festival: its winners, its rules, its ale, and the people who tried to stop it.

categories.prompt: Name a real-world figure the lore mentions
categories.blurb: Aldridge Industries' VIPs and sponsors, puzzle passwords, and other names from Earth.

categories.prompt: Name a historical event or era
categories.blurb: Wars, dynasties, disasters, massacres, trials and one very unfortunate mute button.

categories.prompt: Name a faction, gang or organization
categories.blurb: Councils, cults, gangs, guilds, crews, and the occasional chess club.

categories.prompt: Name a god, spirit or supernatural being
categories.blurb: Deities, walkers, ghosts and the guardians of things that should stay buried.

categories.prompt: Name a job or trade someone in the lore has
categories.blurb: Brewers, bouncers, bards, wind farmers. The work, not the worker.

categories.prompt: Name an item a Liquor King has owned or found
categories.blurb: Crowns, relics, loot, lube. Anything that ended up in a King's pockets.

categories.prompt: Name something from the history of Lagendale
categories.blurb: The lost empire under Hoegaarden: its people, places, rituals and relics.

categories.prompt: Name a mountain, forest, body of water or desert
categories.blurb: The natural lay of the land, from the Breakback range to the eleven seas.

categories.prompt: Name a Liquor King
categories.blurb: Any era: the Six, or any crowned winner of the Drunken Trials.

categories.prompt: Name a nickname, alias or epithet
categories.blurb: Titles, slurs, pseudonyms and pet names. Not the real name.

categories.prompt: Name an Aleforge policy, law or campaign promise
categories.blurb: Enacted by a mayor, passed by the Kings, or shouted from a campaign stage.

categories.prompt: Name someone from Providence or Owe Block
categories.blurb: Tonic-drinking clergy, shopkeepers, gang bosses and the people who run from them.

categories.prompt: Name a place in Providence or Owe Block
categories.blurb: Spires, streets, shops, mines and the burger joint under a crooked manor.

categories.prompt: Name a rank, title or office
categories.blurb: From Providence's church ladder to the Bellows Nation's brew-right. The title, not the person.

categories.prompt: Name a town, nation or realm
categories.blurb: Settlements, empires, islands, and planes of existence you'd rather not visit.

categories.prompt: Name a relic or magical artifact
categories.blurb: Scarabs, glyphs, bells, cursed blades, and things best left in the vault.

categories.prompt: Name something from Roto Kaiishi or the Southern Bellows Nation
categories.blurb: The floating free market and the fog-wrapped nation of terrible IPAs.

categories.prompt: Name something tied to Sackbeard
categories.blurb: His ships, his crew, his kills, his loot, his songs and his betrayal.

categories.prompt: Name a scholar, mystic or holy figure
categories.blurb: Prophets, priests, witches, oracles, librarians and the occasional mage with a telescope.

categories.prompt: Name a ship, crew or sea captain
categories.blurb: Hulls, sky ships, submarines, the crews aboard them, and whoever's at the wheel.

categories.prompt: Name a song, poem or chant
categories.blurb: Ballads, anthems, campaign songs, lullabies and freestyle bars from the Isles.

categories.prompt: Name someone aboard Maximilian's space station
categories.blurb: Crew, captives, or the master himself. From the Liquor King Trials.

categories.prompt: Name a piece of gear or tech from Maximilian's space station
categories.blurb: Keycards, suits, consoles and contraptions from the Liquor King Trials.

categories.prompt: Name a room or section of Maximilian's space station
categories.blurb: Where the Kings woke up, crawled around, died repeatedly, and finally fought Max.

categories.prompt: Name a tavern, bar or inn
categories.blurb: Anywhere a pint gets poured, on the Isles or on the road there.

categories.prompt: Name a character who has died
categories.blurb: Murdered, executed, forgotten in a cage, or poisoned by drink.

categories.prompt: Name a merchant, barkeep or tradesman
categories.blurb: Anyone who sells, pours, farms, paints, or otherwise works for a living.

categories.prompt: Name something tied to the Veilwalkers
categories.blurb: Their home, their customs, their kin, their curses and the people who crossed them.

categories.prompt: Name a villain or antagonist
categories.blurb: Anyone or anything that set out to ruin the Kings, the Isles, or at least their night.

categories.prompt: Name a weapon
categories.blurb: Blades, blickys, cursed spears, and whatever else someone swung in anger.
